hints.title: Worst Case Net Loss Sum
hints.text: Every transaction where cost > cashback reduces our total money by cost - cashback regardless of order.

hints.title: Peak Requirement Analysis
hints.text: In the worst order, all losing transactions happen first. For the last losing transaction, the cashback has not yet been received before paying the cost.

hints.title: Maximum Final Hit
hints.text: The worst drop is the sum of all losses plus either the cashback of a losing transaction or the cost of a non-losing transaction.

hints.title: Worst Case Loss and Cash Buffer Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass calculating net loss sum and peak additional requirement.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all n! permutation orders is computationally impossible.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory accumulates worst-case buffer without allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decomposes worst-case sequence into sum of net losses plus maximum trailing outlay.
